results.Description: THE PURPOSE OF THIS PURCHASE IS TO BUY 600-MINUTE PREPAID VOUCHERS FOR 18 IRIDIUM SATELLITE PHONES.

SSA OIG, AS PART OF THE COOP PROGRAM, HAS 24 SATELLITE PHONES. THE MINUTES ON THE SIM CARDS ASSOCIATED WITH EACH PHONE IS SET TO EXPIRE IN MAY. SSA OIG WOULD LIKE TO RENEW THE MINUTES FOR ALL 24 SATELLITE PHONES.
